# Unused-objects baseline for the Regional Sales Sample.
#
# Distilled from target/regional-sales-unused-analysis.csv (an external
# unused-objects analysis export over the same model in samples/), one object
# per line:
#
#   <ripbi-type>\t<table>\t<object name>\t<expected chain>
#
# expected chain: "orphan"  — externally marked Unused (ripbi: empty used_by)
#                 "chained" — externally marked Used by unused (ripbi: every
#                             consumer itself unused)
# The E2E test in tests/regional_sales.rs asserts every line is a ripbi
# finding with the matching chain shape, that no live object is flagged, and
# that the only extra findings are the fully-dead 'Contacts' table and its
# partition: the export lists no table rows, but with every non-key Contacts
# column dead and only a relationship referencing the table, the table and
# its partition are unused by the documented containment rule.
column	Accounts	Account Number	orphan
column	Accounts	AccountID	orphan
column	Accounts	AccountOwnerSeq	orphan
column	Calculations	Value	orphan
column	Contacts	Contact	orphan
column	Contacts	ContactSeq	orphan
column	Contacts	Job Title	orphan
column	Opportunities	Blank	orphan
column	Opportunities	DateDiff-Days	orphan
column	Opportunities	Days Remaining In Pipeline (bins)	orphan
column	Opportunities	Probability	orphan
column	Opportunities	Probability (raw)	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	DAY	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	DaySeq	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	MONTH	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	MONTH NUMBER	chained
column	Opportunity Calendar	RELATIVE 07 DAY PERIOD	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	RELATIVE 30 DAY PERIOD	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	RELATIVE DAY	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	RELATIVE WEEK	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	WEEK	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	YEAR	orphan
column	Opportunity Calendar	YEAR WEEK	orphan
column	Opportunity Forecast Adjustment	Blank	orphan
column	Territories	Country	orphan
